Version information about etnservice

Source: R/get_version.R
get_version.Rd

Users of the etn package might (probably will) have a local version of etnservice. If there are differences between the version deployed on the API and the version installed locally, this might lead to inconsistent results when switching between local database queries and queries over the API. This function returns version information of the installed version of etnservice, when called over the api, it'll return version information on the version of etnservice deployed via opencpu.

Usage

get_version()

Value

A list with the following elements:

ls

A character vector of the objects in the environment.

version

The version of the etnservice package.

Examples

get_version()
#> $fn_checksums
